annotations.title: Franchise fees for a hotel brand

description: One hotel brand's franchise costs from its filed franchise disclosure document (FDD): royalty, marketing and other percent fees, per-room monthly fees, reservation and loyalty charges, initial and transfer fee for a 60-room hotel, the Item 7 total investment range, FDD date, page references and the filing link. Give rooms and rooms revenue to get the yearly percent and per-room fees for your hotel.

brand.description: Brand name or slug, e.g. "Super 8", "Days Inn", "comfort-inn".

rooms.description: Rooms, for the yearly fee estimate. Default 60.

rooms_revenue.description: Yearly rooms revenue in dollars, for the yearly fee estimate. Default 1500000.

name: get_franchise_costs
